title: Nose Section Skin Panel — Flush Riveted Patch for Impact Damage Below the Radome Bulkhead
abstract: Flush riveted patch repair for impact damage in the nose section skin below the radome bulkhead, typically caused by ground equipment contact during nose servicing.

sections.purpose: This repair restores the static strength and the pressure capability of the nose section skin after impact damage below the radome bulkhead has been cleaned up.
sections.damage_assessment: Establish the extent of the damage by detailed visual inspection and confirm it with an ultrasonic thickness map on a 20 millimetre grid. A dent without cracking and inside the depth limit may be left, blended and re-protected. Damage that reaches a frame or a stringer attachment, damage within 50 millimetres of the radome bulkhead attachment, or damage that has deformed the underlying stringer is outside the scope of this repair. Where the impact has been from ground equipment, inspect the internal face for a corresponding mark on the stringer flange and report it; a deformed stringer flange changes the repair from a skin patch to a structural assessment.
sections.repair_procedure: Rout the damaged material to a smooth oval with a minimum corner radius of 20 millimetres and blend the edges. Do a dye penetrant inspection of the routed edge and confirm that no indication remains. Cut the patch from the sheet stock on repair drawing RD-53-10-12-911 and drill the fastener pattern in the patch first, using it as the drill jig for the skin. Prepare the faying surfaces and apply the chromate-free protection to all bare material. Fit the patch dry and check the fit; a proud patch that stands more than the drawing value above the skin must be re-machined and not pulled down with the fasteners. Install the fasteners wet with sealant, working from the centre outwards, using the fitting ESC60774-53 at the two positions that land on the frame flange. Where the patch reaches the lug D5310125684981, use the shorter fastener given on sheet 2. Seal the patch edge, restore the aerodynamic smoothness class and re-apply the paint scheme including the radome alignment marks.
sections.inspection_requirements: Do a detailed visual inspection of the patch perimeter and a check of the paint scheme at every A check for the first year, then at every C check. An eddy current inspection of the fastener rows is required every 8000 flight cycles. Any crack indication at a fastener hole, or any evidence of pressure leakage past the patch, makes the repair invalid. The repair is not life limited provided the inspection programme is followed.

type_data.allowable_damage_limits: Damage up to 100 by 70 millimetres after clean-up, not reaching a frame or stringer attachment, not within 50 millimetres of the radome bulkhead attachment and with no deformation of the underlying stringer.

repair_drawings.title: Flush riveted patch, nose section skin below radome bulkhead

type_data.fastener_pattern: Two rows, 40 fasteners, 20 mm pitch, 15 mm edge distance, with a staggered outer row
type_data.fatigue_life_note: Not life limited provided the eddy current inspection of the fastener rows is done every 8000 flight cycles.
